title: A 3 × 5: one row left in the middle
notes: A 3 × 5. After the outer ring, 12 values, only the middle of row 1 is left: 7, 8, 9. Then top = 2 is past bottom = 1, so the check before the bottom row stops the walk there. Without that check the spiral would walk row 1 back and list 8 and 7 twice.
